Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Square Floating Metal Wall Mirror, 12 Inch Height, Black
Colors: Glass
Materials: iron
With round glass appearing to float in a four-sided black iron frame, this industrial mirror will turn heads. It's also super functional and sized to be easily displayed on a bureau top, bookcase shelf, or mounted on a wall. Industrial design with black iron frame Glass, iron frame with black finish 12"W x 4"D x 12"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
